detail: Present operator describes two storeys, four arcades, octagonal middle and outer elements, original 1900 semicircular elevation, 1916 alteration, and the low triangular pediment after 1936. The original Baroque-gable motif is recalled on a separate sign outside the plaza.
Cultural heritage record identifies the west-facing two-storey brick mansion and postwar changes.
Cultural Affairs Bureau records construction in 1900 and the Clock Tower nickname based on the historic gable relief.
Municipal record identifies the architect and the historic residence’s change of uses.
